counties.notes: Shawnee County KS (Topeka metro, county seat and state capital Topeka) provides AppraisalDataPro/MapServer/4 (Current Parcels) via the county appraiser's GIS server. This is a 20-field service: OBJECTID, PARCELNUM, ACRES, PID, QUICKREFID, ONAME (owner name), PADDRESS, PADDRESS2, DBOOKPAGE, SUBS (subdivision), NBHD (neighborhood), TAXUNIT, USD (unified school district), LBCSFUNCTION, LBCSACTIVITY, LDVAL, BLDGVAL, TOTVAL, Shape, Shape area. Query confirmed live: UPPER(ONAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results. The same service has layer 0 (Parcel Information with Labels), layer 3 (Parcels 1-1-2024, prior year snapshot), and layer 4 (Current Parcels). The Shawnee County Open Data Portal at data-sncoks-gis.opendata.arcgis.com provides additional datasets. The property search app is at gis.sncoapps.us/propertysearch/. Shawnee County KS (FIPS 20177) must not be confused with Shawnee County Ohio or Shawnee Township. NOTE 2026-06-27: query endpoint responds in 13-35s (server-side slowness. Returns 437,436 features when polled with 35s timeout); liveness check at 12s flags FAIL but endpoint IS live. Metadata returns immediately. PAID MAILING LISTS PAUSED: Kansas law (K.S.A. 45-230) bars selling or giving a list of names and addresses taken from public records for selling to the people listed, so owner mailing lists are paused on paid plans (county-access floor, 2026-11-21, as for Sedgwick County); single-parcel lookups still work.

counties.notes: Sedgwick County, Kansas (FIPS 20173; county seat Wichita). NOT Sedgwick County, Colorado: an ArcGIS Online web map titled 'Sedgwick County Assessor Map' belongs to the Colorado county. Served by the county GIS server's My Local Taxes parcel service (Map/Op_MyLocalTaxes_Cached_SP, layer 0 'Parcels'), the service behind the county's 'My Local Taxes 2025' viewer (gismaps.sedgwickcounty.org/tax/parcelviewer). The service text still says '2015 Tax Parcel service' but AssessmentYear is 2025 on 238,732 of 238,753 rows (2026 on none), so it carries the 2025 roll. Verified 2026-11-21: 238,753 rows; owner name (Owner) on 238,745 (null on 8); owner mailing address (Owner_madd, Owner_City, Owner_Stat, Owner_Zip) on 238,744; property address (Prop_Addr, Prop_City, Prop_zip) on 194,978 (82%). PIN is the 8-digit county parcel id (00589556); AIN is the appraiser number. Owner LIKE %SMITH% returns 1,869 rows; Prop_Addr LIKE %MAIN% 1,296; an exact PIN query returns 1; a point query inside PIN 00589556 (37.6811, -97.3387, downtown Wichita) returns it, while a point on a street right-of-way returns none. The layer also has legal description, land, improvement and total appraised and assessed values, land use, building details, sale year and validity, tax unit, specials and solid-waste fee. maxRecordCount 1000 with pagination; native spatial reference Kansas State Plane South feet, so a point query passes inSR=4326. CORS: the server reflects the request Origin. A WEB FIREWALL fronts the server: on 2026-11-21 it answered 'Request Rejected' (an HTML page, HTTP 200) to where clauses containing <> with an empty string and to outStatistics queries, while LIKE, =, IS NULL and geometry queries passed. Build queries without <> '' (use LIKE '_%' for non-blank). The county's open-data Land Records parcels (services7.arcgis.com/McLat6HlPl45bNBv Sedgwick_County_Land_Records FeatureServer 4) carry ids and geometry only, no owner. License: no licence text on the service; the county's GIS terms are a no-warranty disclaimer with an indemnity. PAID MAILING LISTS PAUSED: Kansas law (K.S.A. 45-230) bars selling or giving a list of names and addresses taken from public records for selling to the people listed, so owner mailing lists are paused on paid plans (county-access floor, 2026-11-21, as for Shawnee County); single-parcel lookups still work. Informational only, not a survey: verify with the Sedgwick County Appraiser. Credit Sedgwick County Geographic Information Services.
